name: ZX_WHT_LINES_SUMMARY
description: This table stores withholding summary tax lines for transactions of multiple event classes.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Internal organization identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, used to identify the type of transaction.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: SUMMARY_TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Summary tax line identifier for a particular tax line.

columns.name: SUMMARY_TAX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Summary withholding tax line number.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for the set of tax rules that determines the treatment of one or more withholding taxes administered by a tax authority.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier for a geographic area where a withholding tax is levied by a specific tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for a geographic area where a withholding tax is levied by a specific tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for the taxable nature of a product in the context of a transaction for a withholding tax.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Tax rate identifier specified for a tax status for an effective time period.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code specified for a tax status for an effective time period, expressed as a percentage or a rate schedule.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Rate specified for a tax status for an effective time period. A tax rate can be expressed as a percentage or a rate schedule.

columns.name: TAX_AMT
columns.description: Withholding tax amount in entered currency.

columns.name: TAX_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: Amount in entered currency converted into withholding tax currency.

columns.name: TAX_AMT_FUNCL_CURR
columns.description: Withholding tax amount in ledger currency.

columns.name: MANUALLY_ENTERED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the withholding tax line is manually entered. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: CANCEL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the withholding tax line is cancelled. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: COMPOUNDING_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether it is a compounding withholding tax line. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: HISTORICAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the withholding tax line is created during migration from prior releases. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPTION_ID
columns.description: Withholding tax exemption identifier used in determination of the effective withholding tax rate.

columns.name: EXEMPT_CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Certificate number for the exemption associated with the withholding transaction.

columns.name: EXEMPT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for a withholding tax exemption.

columns.name: TAX_EXCEPTION_ID
columns.description: Tax exception identifier used in determination of the effective withholding tax rate.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the first party organization of the transaction.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ID
columns.description: Payment identifier associated with a withholding tax line.

columns.name: CHECKRUN_ID
columns.description: Payment process request identifier.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number associated with the withholding tax line.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Payment date associated with the withholding tax line.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier for the accounting information set for single or multiple legal entities, or management entities.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier for a withholding tax transaction.

columns.name: ESTABLISHMENT_ID
columns.description: Establishment identifier, which is now known as the legal reporting unit.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date of the conversion rate for entered currency to withholding tax currency conversion.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for entered currency to withholding tax currency conversion.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type for entered currency to withholding tax currency conversion.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Default accounting date for transactions.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period of the default accounting date for transactions.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_FORMULA
columns.description: Formula code used for determining withholding taxable basis amount.

columns.name: TAX_CALCULATION_FORMULA
columns.description: Formula code used for determining withholding tax amount.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, predefined, or defined by the user.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
